info.name: FlowOps API
info.description: Importable collection for the documented FlowOps API. Run Health first, then Login. Postman stores the flowops_session cookie automatically. Requests that write, delete, or send email can change data or contact real recipients; run those individually and only against a test database.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.user?.organization?.id) pm.environment.set('organizationId', body.user.organization.id); if (body.user?.id) pm.environment.set('userId', body.user.id); }
